_about: When each Unbound location opens up: the checkpoint (next gym) you're preparing for when you first reach it. Built from the Pokémon Unbound Wiki's location pages (connections, requirements, trainers' minimum levels), 2026-11-25. Edit freely; locations missing here keep their wild Pokémon untimed. Labels must match the checkpoints in generated/availability.json.

Icicle Cave.why: connects Bellin Town and Route 2; trainers from Lv 8

Route 2.why: leads to Dresco Town; trainers from Lv 11

Route 3.why: north of Dresco Town; trainers from Lv 12

Route 4.why: west of Dresco, toward Crater Town; confirmed by play

Route 5.why: connects Route 4 and Crater Town; trainers from Lv 19

Valley Cave.why: connects Crater Town to Route 6; trainers from Lv 21

Route 6.why: past Valley Cave; trainers from Lv 22

Route 7.why: west of Route 6; trainers from Lv 23

Frost Mountain.why: connects Route 7 and Route 8; trainers from Lv 24

Route 8.why: ends at Blizzard City; trainers from Lv 25

Frozen Forest.why: edge of Blizzard City; trainers from Lv 27

KBT Expressway.why: Crater Town's south entrance leads to Fallshore, the next stop after the Blizzard City gym

Route 10.why: west of Fallshore City; trainers from Lv 29

Route 9 + Autl Woods.why: west of Tehl Town, past Route 10; trainers from Lv 29

Route 11.why: east of Fallshore; trainers from Lv 29 (the far side needs Cliff Cave)

Cliff Cave.why: needs Strength, 'once you've beaten the gym in Fallshore City' (confirmed by play)

Thundercap Mt..why: reached through Cliff Cave; trainers from Lv 33

Lost Tunnel.why: no wiki page; the gift list places it between Fallshore and Epidimy

Route 12.why: connects Tarmigan Town to Dehara City; trainers from Lv 35. Surf is received here after the rival battle, but needs Dehara City's Battery Badge to use outside battle (both confirmed by play), so water encounters start after Galavan

Route 13.why: unsure: runs from Route 4 to Dehara City, so likely opened from the Dehara side

Route 14.why: unsure: between Route 6 and Route 12, likely opened from the Route 12 side

Ruins of Void.why: the story takes you here from Dehara City; trainers from Lv 38

Great Desert.why: between Dehara City and Gurun Town; trainers from Lv 39

Vivill Woods.why: connects Gurun Town to Vivill Town; trainers from Lv 41

Antisis Sewers.why: no wiki page; under Antisis City

Route 16.why: south to Gurun Town, branches to Antisis City; trainers from Lv 46

Auburn Waterway.why: unsure: between Route 6 and Route 10 by water; trainers from Lv 52

Route 15.why: unsure: between Route 2 and Vivill Town; trainers from Lv 52

Route 17.why: between Route 16 and Seaport City; trainers from Lv 50

Cootes Bog.why: north of Polder Town (after Tessy), leads to Magnolia Town

Magnolia Fields.why: no wiki page; between Magnolia Town and Redwood Village

Redwood Forest.why: no wiki page; by Redwood Village

Route 18.why: between Gurun Town and Victory Road

Bellin Town.why: the first town after Frozen Heights

Crater Town.why: Vega's gym town, south of Route 5

Blizzard City.why: Alice's gym town, at the end of Route 8

Epidimy Town.why: between Route 11 (past Cliff Cave) and Thundercap Mountain

Tarmigan Town.why: between Route 11 and Route 12; trainers from Lv 33

Vivill Town.why: north of Vivill Woods; trainers from Lv 44

Antisis City.why: Big Mo's gym town; trainers from Lv 47

Seaport City.why: end of Route 17; a sailor goes on to Polder Town

Polder Town.why: Tessy's gym town; trainers from Lv 52

Magnolia Town.why: north of Cootes Bog; trainers from Lv 50

Redwood Village.why: Benjamin's gym town, past Magnolia Fields

Crystal Peak.why: the raid tables mark it post-game

Tomb of Borrius.why: no wiki page; legendary location behind missions
